name: Conqueror's Foothold
description: A Legion of Dusk fortress and prison on mainland Ixalan, where captives are executed to sustain vampiric rituals.

description_citations.text: "Conqueror's Foothold". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Vona joined the first fleet to Ixalan and established the Foothold as a stronghold for her own ambitions.
timeline.quote: Vona joined the first fleet to cross the sea to Ixalan .

citation.text: "Conqueror's Foothold", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Vona discovered a map to the Hierophant's Chalice and used the Foothold and its prisoners to search for it.
timeline.quote: Vona discovered a map leading to the Hierophant's Chalice, an artifact said to create an endless supply of blood.

citation.text: "Conqueror's Foothold", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Alante turned against Vona, stole the map, freed the prisoners and led them to the Temple of Aclazotz, securing the Chalice for her order.
timeline.quote: Stealing the map, she freed the doomed prisoners and led them to the Temple of Aclazotz ahead of Vona’s forces, ultimately securing the Chalice for her order and thwarting Vona’s plan.

citation.text: "Conqueror's Foothold", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

relations.quote: Until she left for Orazca , Conqueror's Foothold was commanded by Vona de Iedo
